title: How is Rivaldo connected to Lil Wayne?
description:
Four real photos link 2002 World Cup winner Rivaldo to Lil Wayne, through Ronaldinho and two presidents.

Rivaldo → Ronaldinho → Jair Bolsonaro → Donald Trump → Lil Wayne

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
